exceptions.rationale: Locked only via orkestr-v2-ui's optional mobile feature (dioxus-desktop 0.7 -> gtk 0.18 on Linux/BSD). cargo tree 2026-11-12: absent from the workspace and server on all targets, the shipped wasm32 UI (web,execution-controls) and mobile builds for iOS and Android; no workflow builds the UI for desktop Linux. No Orkestr code uses glib or VariantStrIter. Fix is glib 0.20; gtk 0.18 cannot take it and dioxus-desktop 0.7 needs wry 0.53/tao 0.34 (gtk 0.18).

Build-time only: phf_generator 0.8 in the selectors 0.24 build script, via kuchikiki 0.8.8 which wry 0.53.5 pins for Android, under orkestr-v2-ui's optional mobile feature. cargo tree 2026-11-12: absent from the workspace, server and shipped wasm32 UI on all targets. The advisory needs rand's log feature and a custom logger calling thread_rng; rand 0.7.3 has no log dependency in Cargo.lock. The 0.7 line has no fix; removal needs dioxus 0.8 (alpha only).

Marvin timing attack on RSA private-key decryption. Locked only through sqlx-mysql 0.8.6, sqlx's optional MySQL driver; the workspace enables only sqlite. cargo tree --all-features --target all (2026-11-12) finds rsa and sqlx-mysql in no build graph: they are lockfile-only. Orkestr has no RSA code and no MySQL connection, so there is no decryption oracle. Fixed in rsa 0.10.0, which only sqlx 0.9 uses; that upgrade needs the vendored sqlx-sqlite 0.8.6 patch ported.
